description: This source file implements the code-behind logic for the login page of an online examination system. It handles page load, user login for students by verifying credentials against a database, and login for teachers and admin through hardcoded credentials. It facilitates navigation to different pages based on user roles.

classes.name: LoginPage
classes.description: A code-behind class for handling login page events in an ASP.NET Web Forms application.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Event handler for the page load event; currently empty.

methods.name: signupB
methods.description: Handles the signup button click event; transfers user to the SignUpPage.

methods.name: loginButton_Click
methods.description: Handles user login attempts; verifies credentials against database for students or checks hardcoded credentials for teachers/admin, then navigates accordingly.
